thread:
elaine (eng-security): Quick follow-up from last night's authz incident. Root cause: one legacy service (svc-auth-v1) was not checking JWT 'aud' claim, which let an older client token be accepted. Posting remediation + owners below — please reply with short status and blockers.

elaine (eng-security): Observed signals: 13 token-validation-failure spikes at 03:12 UTC, 401s downshift after rollback, and a handful of downstream perm-errors. Logs: `svc-auth-v1` shows `missing claim: aud` for ~320 requests.

raj (eng-runtime): I pushed a canary that enforces aud+exp checks to the v1 cluster at 04:10 UTC. Canary covers ~10% traffic. Patch: https://our-jira/INF-1729. No errors in initial 2h. ETA to promote stable: 6h if metrics look good.

sophie (eng-platform): I'll own audit logging: add a distinct log line for token validation reasons and route to security-audit index. Plan: feature flag -> ship -> 7d retention for now. Ticket INF-1740, target: EOD Thu. Blocker: need schema approval from @oliver for the new field names.

oliver (eng-security): Confirmed. Schema OK. Also recommend rotating the long-lived key used by the legacy client — the token in question maps to a service credential that hasn't rotated in 14 months. I'll own rotation with infra. INF-1741. Proposed rotation window: Sun 02:00-03:00 UTC to minimize traffic.

maria (oncall): Noting recurring pattern: this is the 3rd time in last 4 months we've had audience-mismatch issues from older SDKs. Suggest adding an automated smoke test in our CI that validates aud expectations for all public clients. Who owns?

raj (eng-runtime): I can add a lightweight smoke test in the runtime test suite. Will open INF-1742, aim: next sprint. Quick check: adding test won't break canary today.

elaine (eng-security): Action items summary (please react :heavy_check_mark: when acknowledged):
- INF-1729 (raj) — promote aud+exp enforcement to stable; ETA 6h.
- INF-1740 (sophie) — central audit logs for token validation failures; ETA EOD Thu.
- INF-1741 (oliver + eng-infra) — rotate long-lived credential and set max TTL=24h; window Sun 02:00-03:00 UTC.
- INF-1742 (raj) — CI smoke test to catch aud mismatches across SDK versions; ETA next sprint.
- Follow-up: weekly 15m postmortem sync for 4 weeks to verify no recurrence (owner: maria).

infra-bot: Deployment canary started for svc-auth-v1 at 04:11 UTC — job id deploy-20260322-7.

sophie (eng-platform): Acknowledged. I'll send the audit schema PR by EOD.

oliver (eng-security): Acknowledged and starting rotation runbook updates now. Will ping infra channel when ready.

raj (eng-runtime): Acknowledged. Monitoring dashboard updated: added `token.aud_fail_rate` panel and alert threshold at 5/min.

maria (oncall): Acknowledged. I'll schedule the weekly 15m sync starting Mon 10:00 UTC and invite stakeholders.

elaine (eng-security): Thanks everyone. Please update the respective INF tickets with progress and blockages. I'll check back in 24h for a status snapshot.

sophie (eng-platform): Quick note — we should also validate audit-log coverage for private-dedicated deployments. Adding to INF-1740 checklist.

raj (eng-runtime): Noted. If we find any dedicated clusters with the old image, I'll raise a config-alert.

elaine (eng-security): If anyone spots any related spike after changes, ping @maria and me immediately.

maria (oncall): Closing loop for now, will post the first 24h status in this thread once we have stable metrics. :thumbsup:
